reason: Excel, the whiteboard and Xero run my bookings fine, and I've never paid for operations software. Over A$400 a month, even with the discount, from a company with no customers, and a migration in the middle of excursion and end-of-year season? That's a no for me.
objection: Nobody has used it yet. I'm not handing my bookings and driver rosters to a brand-new company and trusting it not to drop a job on a busy Friday, refund or no refund.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it run for a few months at another coach operator my size that I can actually ring, with the switchover done in the quiet months and not in peak season.
